notes: Country: United States, certainty medium-high - modern farmhouse style (board-and-batten siding, standing-seam metal roof, timber knee braces, brick-veneer foundation skirt, side-load garage), 6'8" door proportions. No license plates, mailbox or signage visible. Calc profile US, [US] + [INVARIANT] catalog sections only.
Images are architectural renderings (CGI), not photographs; sizes are therefore as-designed, lighting and colors idealized.

Photo assessment: 1 = front, frontal, occluded ~5% (shrubs); 2 = front + left elevation from front-left corner, front yaw ~35 deg, left yaw ~65 deg, left occluded ~10%; 3 = front from front-right, yaw ~30 deg, right elevation only a sliver; 4 = right elevation (yaw ~60 deg) + back elevation (yaw ~25 deg) from rear-right corner, occluded ~5% (patio furniture).
depth_basis: oblique_only - no photo shows the left or right elevation frontally or slightly angled.
Perspective: widths from photos 2/3/4 divided by cos(yaw) with yaws above. Photo 1: bays stand ~2.4 m in front of the porch wall; door-based scale (porch plane) corrected to bay plane.
Wide-angle: in photo 2 the far left end (garage doors) lies in the outer 10% of the frame - depth chain from photo 2 possibly compressed; photo 4 preferred as second chain.

Penetrations: no pipes, vents or chimneys visible on any roof face (clean standing-seam render) - 0 entries. No gutters or downspouts visible - downspouts empty. No visible damage - condition_areas empty.
Rear patio (photo 4) is an open slab at grade with furniture - not a volume, not reported as attachment.
Openings counted across all photos: front 5 (W-1..W-4, D-1), left 5 (G-1, G-2, W-5..W-7), right 3 (W-8..W-10), back 4 (W-11, W-12, D-2, D-3) = 17.
